Messages.Author: wolflord
Messages.Body:
Hiya guys,
Couldn't find anything on the topic, so here's a question which arose
last night during fun play:

Suppose you have a merged Lambach in play.
The man gets a hold of NEC (either through Saron Fragment, Skill cards
or whatever..)

Would brining back a vamp from your ash heap with either Daemonic
Possession or Possesion trigger his untap ability?

My guess would be no, as the wording on both actions is "move from ash
heap to controlled region"
On the other hand, he does untap after performing actoins like Embrace
,which don't hold the "put a vampire into play" text either, they
usually say "put *this card* into play.."
So according to the logic, it might as well work out with the NEC
actions..

Thanks in advance,
Greetz
Jo
